mode: Primary-coordinated native OpenCode invocation plus separately labeled scenario analysis

native_case.inputs: Stable committed skill, core and agent instruction files; all accesses read-only
native_case.outputs: Separate temporary JSON reports, no shared writers
native_case.A: Audit tool-specific worker and verifier permission boundaries
native_case.B: Analyze concrete execution scenarios against revised owning skills
native_case.C: Audit user-facing guidance and local reference targets
expected: Launch A and B through supported native background calls before waiting for either result
Queue C until a completion frees a slot; if another worker remains active, demonstrate safe same-layer refill
At most two live native children; each assignment once
Primary may validate stable metadata during active workers, without modifying their inputs or outputs
Review all three artifacts before T03 acceptance and later T04 dispatch
native_case.timing_rule: No sleeps, artificial delays or polling to manufacture overlap. Capture actual launch handles, notifications and worker-recorded UTC start/end times. If workers finish too quickly for refill overlap, report eligibility only rather than fabricate evidence.

scenario_cases: Three compatible siblings, limit two; accepted prerequisites, no resource conflict
Pending later-layer task whose own dependency is done but active layer has unfinished sibling
Distinct file paths with a shared generated output or external service
Shared immutable source reads and disjoint outputs
Failure in one sibling while another remains active
Read-only reviewers of stable inputs with available budget
Worker asked to create nested subagents
limits: Scenario decisions are static reasoning, not executed host failures or unsafe writes
This does not establish automatic skill routing or causal improvement over a baseline
No speed/cost benchmark or live Claude runtime claim
Existing worker permissions remain unchanged; primary owns native dispatch and evidence consolidation
